text.tspan: A promise settles once and stays settled. Every .then returns a NEW promise.
Once settled, a promise can never change state or value again.
Attaching .then later still fires, with the value it already has.
Each link is a new promise
Returning a value fulfills the next promise;
throwing rejects it. That is why one .catch at
the end covers the whole chain, and why
Callbacks you attach are queued as MICROTASKS, so they always run after the current synchronous code finishes
and before the next timer or DOM event, even when the promise settled long ago.
